description: Corrected gold labels for 13 SciFact training-set claim-document pairs
source_paper: Gold Label Errors in the SciFact Benchmark: An LLM-Assisted Annotation Audit

corrections.justification: Evidence states 'no association was detected between bariatric surgery and cancer'
Same study; no association with cancer including breast cancer
Evidence reports significantly less morphine use (P=.03); claim says 'increased'
'Reduced stimulatory capacity' = represses, which supports the claim
Anti-CTLA-4 doesn't reinvigorate exhausted T cells per evidence
Study explicitly recruited adults who 'did not meet criteria for dementia'; claim says 'Individuals with Alzheimers'
Evidence is about RHBDL4; claim attributes function to signal peptide peptidase (different enzyme)
Evidence shows effect modification, not that APOE4 causes longer reproductive period
Paper is about bovine SCNT; claim says 'human'
Paper is about vertebrate nucleosomes; claim says 'yeasts'
Evidence is a microsimulation projection, not observed reduction
Evidence reports ~15 million hospitalizations; claim says '30 million cases'
